Inspect first. Run locally. Compare the result.

Download an experiment and open a terminal in the folder where you saved it. For example:

python3 01_coupled_repair.py

Each script prints a computed JSON report. Compare it with its linked report, then inspect the source and change the supplied parameters to explore further.

A clear scope for exploration

These are deterministic finite models with supplied meanings, references and checks. All actions are simulated. Receiving permission starts off; declared comparison censuses supply simulated grants explicitly.

The software permits noncommercial study and code experiments under its full terms. Commercial use needs separate written permission. Read the licence and enquiries page →

01

Experiment 01

The Missing Distinction

Repair a judgment and the view it depends on. Better reasoning and a richer context map work together to recover justified answers from the same evidence.

Inspect a finite five-bit encounter, rule/view interventions, qualification boundaries and separate receiving permission.

01_coupled_repair.py

02

Experiment 02

Carry the Method Forward

Carry an acquired construction method into a fresh receiving context. Remove it, restore it, and compare the resulting acquisition and decisions.

Four target requests; inherited, removed, restored and direct-search controls. The advantage is specific to the declared grammar.

Download Python · 02Inspect the code ↗Computed report ↗Try the interactive experiment →

02_qualified_inheritance.py

03

Experiment 03

Ask What Matters

Construct useful questions from disagreement between possible actions. Watch missing evidence become a targeted enquiry rather than a blind guess.

Twelve represented cases, declared enquiry costs and duties, plus separate outside-library failures.

Download Python · 03Inspect the code ↗Computed report ↗Try the interactive experiment →

03_constructive_enquiry.py

04

Experiment 04

Learn What Was Missing

Use an audited failure to acquire and validate a missing response expression. Freeze the repaired library and test it on fresh cases.

105 represented test cases, expression removal/restoration and an additional uninstalled-predicate stress boundary.

Download Python · 04Inspect the code ↗Computed report ↗Try the interactive experiment →

04_acquired_expression.py

05

Experiment 05

Extend How Repairs Are Built

Learn an OR constructor that changes the available construction language, then use it to acquire a different repair on a later task.

26 → 47 candidate programs, preservation checks, removal/restoration controls and a three-peak target beyond the one-pair language.

Download Python · 05Inspect the code ↗Computed report ↗Try the interactive experiment →

05_bounded_meta_extension.py

06

Experiment 06

What Does Better Checking Cost?

Compare fitting alone with checked adoption under the same later-learning task. Inspect the work charged for validation and preservation.

Declared operation counts, frozen response checks and faulty-feedback holds. This model does not establish faster alignment development.

Download Python · 06Inspect the code ↗Computed report ↗Try the interactive experiment →

06_resource_comparison.py

07

Experiment 07

When the Obligations Change

Reuse the learned constructor under changed responsibilities. Learn a new rule, identify a context collision, and renew qualification for its use.

272 frozen eligibility cases; supplied grants permit 26 valid simulated releases. Test stale receipts, wrong feedback, missing authority and unsupported rules.

Download Python · 07Inspect the code ↗Computed report ↗Try the interactive experiment →

07_changing_obligations.py
